summary: Adopt one shared origin-validating and capped-JSON route factory across exactly the 13 pre-existing unguarded mutating routes named in TODO.md, preserving their request schemas, controller semantics, bodyless rebuild behavior, and no-Content-Type-gate parsing.

checklist.step: Confirm the TODO.md inventory and identify exactly the 13 named routes without expanding the accepted boundary.
checklist.verification_check: Compare the implementation route list with TODO.md and verify that only [workItemId] PATCH, [workItemId]/edit PATCH, the six mission routes, patch-plan, portfolio/work-items, work-items/rebuild, and workspaces are included.

checklist.step: Implement or reuse one shared route factory combining fail-closed Origin validation with the existing capped JSON parser, while leaving work-items/rebuild bodyless and preserving every existing schema and controller call.
checklist.verification_check: Inspect the factory and all adopted routes to confirm JSON-consuming routes use the common factory/parser, rebuild receives only the origin guard, and no Content-Type requirement is added.

checklist.step: Apply the factory to all 13 routes and retain each route's current same-origin mutation behavior and controller semantics.
checklist.verification_check: Run focused route tests showing valid same-origin requests succeed with unchanged behavior and missing or wrong Origin requests are rejected before mutation.

checklist.step: Cover parser and route rejection behavior for oversized bodies, malformed JSON, and unknown request keys across the adopted JSON-consuming routes.
checklist.verification_check: Run focused shared-parser and route tests demonstrating deterministic rejection for oversized or malformed JSON and unknown keys, alongside the origin cases.
